data.title: Israel's Ambassador to UAE says Iran war brought Gulf States, Israel closer | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "Israel-UAE relations have reached a new peak," Israel's Ambassador to the United Arab Emirates, Yossi Shelley, told The Jerusalem Post in an exclusive interview.
